metadata.description: Curated demo subset of the route_arms dataset of 'Where a coding ban takes effect in Qwen3-8B' (CRN-coupled KV-splice route test on 12 frozen bench tasks).
metadata.source: full_method_out.json -> datasets[route_arms] (+ per-arm token ids from data/samples.jsonl)
metadata.selection_rule: gated tasks ['T03', 'T06', 'T05', 'T10', 'T13']: slots k < 3 of every template; first 5 non-gated tasks in STAGE_A order ['T04', 'R1', 'T08', 'R3', 'R6']: slot k < 1 of every template
metadata.example_format: output = arm-a (full ban) label; predict_<arm> = '<mechanism label>|pass' or '|fail' (program passed the task tests) or 'not_run'; metadata_token_ids = generated ids per arm
metadata.decoding: T=1.0, top-p 1.0, no top-k, max 1024 new tokens, CRN inverse-CDF sampling
metadata.hardware: 1 x NVIDIA L4 23 GB, 6 CPUs, 66 GB RAM

full_run_reference.note: headline numbers of the full run (all 13,030 samples; N = 100 CRN slots per task and arm)

engine_slot.note: frozen Qwen3 prompt ids (ban / token-length-matched neutral twin_A) and the Qwen3-8B rows of the same CRN slots (same uniforms) from data/samples.jsonl
